primary_meaning: the final place of eternal fiery punishment and torment for the wicked after divine judgment (hell)

alternatives.meaning: final irreversible destruction or annihilation of the wicked (not eternal conscious torment)
metaphorical image of severe divine judgment or separation from God rather than a literal postmortem location of fire
the historical Valley of Hinnom as a symbol of temporal national judgment or disgrace (not primarily an afterlife locale)
temporary purgatorial or purifying fire leading ultimately to restoration

notes: Traditional Christian teaching across Catholic, Orthodox, and most Protestant sources equates Gehenna with the lake of fire as eternal hell; debates concern duration/nature of punishment and literal vs. figurative reading but do not displace the primary identification.
